verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for an email product, but nothing in the evidence shows Fastmail's app or mail pipeline can be self-hosted. The JMAP open-standard material describes a protocol that others could implement, which is only a developer building block and earns no credit. The "Open source and standards" page is a bare title with no self-hosting content.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
